## What lands

- **`exports/src/exports/search_query_v2.py`** — the serving half of K3 §4.2 over `sig.release-search-index/2`:
  - **Stage 0 identifier** — record key / entity id / claim id (via `claim_ref`) / catalog doc id → the exact thing, stops.
  - **Tier 1 aliases** — case-sensitive acronyms compare the RAW query (never normalized: a word-hit of "ice" can never present as ICE — SIG-SRCH-005); word-hits collapse under `collapsed_reason` (re-opened by `expand=1`). Case-insensitive terms resolve through `exact_names` basis `alias`; a `target` resolves to its SIG doc.
  - **Tier 1 exact names** — official/alternate/identifier names resolve first (SIG-SRCH-004); every homonym is shown with its parent, ordered by records held then level; a place card carries its evidence basis (`records.total/sources` + the scoped `/search/?jurisdiction=` link).
  - **Tier 2 catalog text** — weighted FTS bm25(name 10, alternates 6, context 1) × the type prior (`score − ln(prior)` merge — never popularity).
  - **Tiers 2–4 records** — per compartment, `bm25(name 10, place 2, source 1)`; per-hit tier = name phrase (2) · all words in name (3) · words only in place/source (4); groups merge by tier (cross-compartment bm25 never compared — K3 §4.2). A name-only query resolves records as a FILTER (exact count + scoped link), never text hits. Per-group keyset cursors (`<group>:<token>`, v2 format pinned on publication/filter) — "More records in this licence group", never a global page number.
  - **Stage 5 suggestion** — only when nothing strong matched: per-word nearest vocabulary term (edit distance 1 ≤ 8 letters else 2, first/last letter shared), kept ONLY if the corrected query finds strong results; `query.suggestion` always says so.
  - **Carried-over bounds + barrier** — 200-code-point q ceiling, ≤ 50 rows/group page, 2 s deadline (progress handler + row-granular check, `query_timeout` 503), 100 KiB wire bound (tail rows drop re-minting the cursor), and the access-time denial barrier evaluated per candidate before pagination with DR-C4-09 deny counting into `excluded_records_by_reason`.
  - **`sig.search-results/2`** — `release` / `query` / `scope` (`records_indexed`, `records_searched`, `groups_searched`, `excluded_records_by_reason`) / `top` / `sections` / `record_groups` / `facets` / `empty` (`no_match` · `filtered_to_zero` with `matching_without_filters`) / `truncated`.
  - **`open_release`** — SIG-SRCH-011's serve path: stream-hash every v2 artifact against the integrity manifest before any `mode=ro` open; drift fails, never silently served.
- **`exports/src/exports/search_benchmark.py`** — `sig.search-benchmark/1`: dev / release / held-out modes; top-3 success + MRR + zero-result rate + misleading-top-hit count + measured p50/p95/max latency. Held-out mode: `load_held_out_descriptor` reads only the committed descriptor; `verify_held_out_blob` sha256-verifies supplied bytes against it — a mismatch is refused, never read (B-28 = b made structural). The estimand label `agent-authored held-out set; not independent` travels every metric surface (TS-20, always); dev reports carry `agent-authored development set; not independent`.
- **`exports/src/exports/data/search_dev_queries.json`** — the committed dev set (`sig.search-benchmark-queries/1`, 40 persona-derived queries, agent-authored expectations — labelled).
- **`sig-exports search-benchmark`** — the release + held-out legs (offline; exit 4 on digest/contract refusal).
- **`tests/exports/test_search_query_v2.py`** — 26 tests: every stage, homonym ordering, filter-mode, cursors + context mismatch, suggestion stated/never-silent, facets, withdrawal barrier + counts, bounds, `open_release` end-to-end on a built release, the seal boundary (descriptor-only; forged blob refused; no emit-path import in the modules), the capstone A1/J2 legs, and the benchmark metrics/labels.
